subject: Native playback confirms failed Ford identity proof; further runs held
body:

The executed graph matches the pre-run graph; root found no obvious bypass or mask-polarity fault. The cause is still being investigated.

Job 569bec13-c8d8-4767-bddf-070b6765708b reports 45.46 seconds and 0.013 compute hours. These are reported execution metrics, not an inferred credit/dollar charge. Further runs are held. The original accepted source remains unchanged and the new proof is unaccepted.

Ziggy's concern-relay authorization persists. Native Nova Dot delivery remains unavailable; this is posted in the local mailbox only. No delivery, reading or wakeup is established, and no user action is requested by this notice.
